faqs.question: What services does EdgeBrain Studios offer?
faqs.answer: We specialize in four core areas: custom web development using modern frameworks like Next.js and React, cross-platform mobile app development, AI automation and workflow optimization, and AI integration consulting. Every engagement is tailored to your specific business needs.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Most projects ship within 4–8 weeks from kickoff to launch. MVPs and marketing sites can go live in as little as 2–3 weeks. Enterprise platforms with complex integrations may take 3–4 months. We deliver iteratively, so you see working software every week.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups or enterprises?
faqs.answer: Both. We’ve helped early-stage startups launch their first product and supported enterprise teams building internal tools and customer-facing platforms. Our process scales to fit — lean for startups, structured for larger organizations.

faqs.question: What does your tech stack look like?
faqs.answer: Our core stack includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python. For mobile, we use React Native and Flutter. On the AI side, we work with OpenAI, custom ML pipelines, and vector databases. Infrastructure runs on AWS, Vercel, and Docker.

faqs.question: How do you handle AI integration?
faqs.answer: We start by identifying where AI creates the most value in your workflow — not where it’s trendiest. Then we build proof-of-concepts to validate the approach before committing to a full build. Our AI integrations include LLM-powered features, document processing, automated workflows, and intelligent agents.

faqs.question: What’s your pricing model?
faqs.answer: We work on a project basis with fixed-scope pricing, so you know the cost upfront. For ongoing partnerships, we offer monthly retainers. Every engagement starts with a free discovery call to scope the work and align on budget.
